{{Quote|Actually, I'm in the fleet end of the Imperial military. My usual command is a fleet-arm of clawcraft. And my father is very proud of me.|Chak Fel|<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''Fleet-arms''' were divisions of [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|''Nssis''-class Clawcraft]] in the [[Empire of the Hand]]. They were led by an officer holding the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="SQ" />
